interface.longDescription: Landfillom by Agel AI is a management platform for landfills and waste facilities in Greece. Connect an existing Landfillom account to work with the facilities you are authorized for: weighings, operational and compliance statistics, HMA (Greek Electronic Waste Registry) reports, partners, documents, staff and maintenance records, and scheduled report deliveries. The assistant only sees the facilities granted to your account. Write actions show a preview and ask for your explicit confirmation before anything is saved or sent. Generated files are delivered as expiring download links.
defaultPrompt: Δείξε τη σύνοψη της εγκατάστασής μου για φέτος.
Ετοίμασε τις εκθέσεις ΗΜΑ για τον προηγούμενο μήνα.
Πόσοι τόνοι παραλήφθηκαν ανά κωδικό ΕΚΑ φέτος;

positive.description: P1: List the facilities the account may see and summarize the synthetic review facility
positive.prompt: Ποιες εγκαταστάσεις μπορώ να δω; Δείξε τη σύνοψη της Review ΧΥΤΑ για το 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Only the facility 'Review ΧΥΤΑ' is listed; the 2026 summary shows 2 weighings and 3 tonnes.

positive.description: P2: List the weighings of one day
positive.prompt: Δείξε τις ζυγίσεις της Review ΧΥΤΑ στις 15/09/2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Two synthetic weighings on 2026-09-15, 1,000 kg and 2,000 kg, 3 tonnes in total.

positive.description: P3: Operational tonnage for the year
positive.prompt: Πόσοι τόνοι παραλήφθηκαν στη Review ΧΥΤΑ το 2026;
positive.expected_behavior: 3 tonnes from 2 weighings, 1 carrier, waste code (EKA) 20 03 01.

positive.description: P4: Generate the monthly HMA reports with preview and confirmation, then download
positive.prompt: Ετοίμασε τις εκθέσεις ΗΜΑ της Review ΧΥΤΑ για τον Σεπτέμβριο 2026. (After the preview: «Ναι, προχώρα.»)
positive.expected_behavior: A preview is shown without writing; after confirmation the job finishes and one report for 'Synthetic Review Carrier' (3 tonnes) is listed with an expiring download link to an XLSX file.

positive.description: P5: Update a partner note through preview and explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: Άλλαξε τη σημείωση του συνεργάτη Synthetic Review Carrier σε “Review test approved”. (After the preview: «Ναι, άλλαξέ τη.»)
positive.expected_behavior: The preview shows the note changing from empty to 'Review test approved'; it is saved only after confirmation and a re-read shows the new value.

negative.description: Household recycling advice is general public information, not a landfill operator's records: the plugin should not be called
negative.prompt: Πού μπορώ να ανακυκλώσω παλιές μπαταρίες και λάμπες στη Ρόδο;

negative.description: A general essay about waste policy needs no facility data: the assistant should answer from its own knowledge without the plugin
negative.prompt: Γράψε μου ένα σύντομο κείμενο για το πώς η ΕΕ μειώνει την υγειονομική ταφή αποβλήτων.

negative.description: Municipal collection timetables are not held in Landfillom: the plugin should not be called
negative.prompt: Τι ώρα περνάει το απορριμματοφόρο από τη γειτονιά μου αύριο;

publication.release_notes: Landfillom is now available in ChatGPT. Connect your existing Landfillom account to see the facilities you are authorized for, their weighings and operational statistics, and to prepare HMA (Greek Electronic Waste Registry) reports. Any change is shown to you first as a preview and is saved only after your explicit confirmation.
